body:
Hi Scott and Silas,

I spent some time on your website this week. The homepage does not carry your name where it counts. The page title literally reads "Columbus ga roofing companies", and below it sits one long wall of text with no phone number and no way to book an inspection until someone digs through the whole page. Your contact page even repeats the same paragraph twice. A homeowner with water dripping through the ceiling is not going to read all that. They will call whoever makes it easiest.

That is a shame, because your actual pitch is strong: veteran-owned, family-operated, free inspections and straight answers. So I rebuilt your homepage around exactly that, and it is attached to this email as a PDF. Your name up front, both phone numbers one tap away, your services laid out clearly, your Columbus to LaGrange service area, and a free inspection button a worried homeowner can hit in seconds.

Roofing sites are a big part of my work. I built leal-roofing.com for a roofing company that leads with inspections and repairs. I also built severeweatherroofing.com for storm damage calls, where speed matters most.

If you like it, I can put it on your real domain and build out the rest of the site. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings.

Best,
Hassan
name: Matter-of-Fact Roofing, LLC
subject: 🏠 Your homepage title still says "Columbus ga roofing companies"
